newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to replace Telecom chairman.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to replace Telecom chairman.

text.p: The Pakistani government plans to replace the chairman of state-owned Pakistan Telecommunication Co Ltd (PTCL) with Nasim Mirza, currently chairman of ICI Pakistan Ltd, government officials said on Sunday.
They said Mirza's appointment, in place of PTCL Chairman Mian Javed, was likely to be announced on Monday.
Government plans to sell a 26 percent stake in PTCL and transfer management control to a strategic investor have hit repeated delays since the original target date of December 1995.

Salman Shah, newly-appointed chairman of the state privatisation commission, said last week that the government wanted to satisfy the concerns of international buyers about certain regulatory and management aspects of PTCL before inviting bids. He did not elaborate.
